meta_data.base_class: retrieve visitation statistics for a given <public cultural institution> - these institutions are open to the public and record attendance over time.

city.description: The city where the <class> is located.

year.description: The year for which data is to be fetched.

time_granularity.description: The level of detail for the visitation statistics. Options: 'daily', 'monthly', or 'yearly'.

visitor_type.description: The type of visitors for the <class>, being 'individual', 'family', or 'group'.

age_group.description: The age group of visitors for the <class>, being 'children', 'teens', 'adults', or 'all'.

seasonal_period.description: The specific season to filter the visitation statistics of the <class>. Options are 'summer', 'winter', 'spring', or 'fall'.
